content.text: Amazon Bedrock is a fully managed service that makes foundation models from leading AI companies available through a single API.
What models are available on Bedrock?
Bedrock provides access to models from Anthropic (Claude), Meta (Llama), AI21 Labs (Jurassic), Cohere (Command), Amazon (Titan), and Stability AI (Stable Diffusion).
What are common use cases for Bedrock?
Common use cases include text generation, conversational AI, chatbots, code generation, image generation, question answering with RAG, and content creation.
Amazon Bedrock offers on-demand and provisioned throughput pricing options with pay-as-you-go pricing and no upfront commitments.
What is RAG in Amazon Bedrock?
RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) is a feature that allows Bedrock to retrieve relevant information from knowledge bases to augment model responses with accurate, up-to-date information.
What security features does Bedrock provide?
Bedrock provides data encryption at rest and in transit, VPC support, AWS PrivateLink, IAM integration, and compliance with standards like HIPAA, GDPR, and SOC.
How do I create a Knowledge Base in Bedrock?

To create a Knowledge Base, go to the Bedrock console, select Knowledge Bases, provide a data source (S3, web crawl, etc.), choose an embedding model, and configure a vector database like OpenSearch or Aurora.
What embedding models are available in Bedrock?
Bedrock offers Amazon Titan Embeddings (text and multimodal versions) and Cohere Embed models for generating vector embeddings.
